hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -Eq "(^|[|&;]) *(mysql|mysqldump|psql|pg_dump)\b"; then host=$(printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -oP "(?:-h ?|--host[= ])\K[^ '\''\"]+" | head -n1); if [ -n "$host" ] && [ "$host" != "127.0.0.1" ] && [ "$host" != "localhost" ] && [ "$host" != "::1" ]; then jq -n --arg host "$host" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse", permissionDecision:"ask", permissionDecisionReason:("Comando de BD aponta para host remoto: " + $host + " — a confirmar manualmente.")}}'; fi; fi
